voice.description: A cheerful Northern English man in his mid thirties, warm medium-pitch voice with a smooth texture and a gentle Yorkshire lilt. Speaks at an easy lively pace, friendly and upbeat, smiling as he talks.

error.styleInstruction: speaking urgently, slightly strained and apologetic

warning.styleInstruction: speaking carefully, a note of caution

success.styleInstruction: speaking very fast, bright and full

prompt.styleInstruction: speaking clearly with rising, expectant intonation
